Name: Cream Modern Kitchen
Author: Suzilana
Description:
[ Content Patcher ] mod that transforme the kitchen in a cool retro modern vibe.

Farmhouse, Cabin and Island available, but you can choose to install only one in the config file.

I also made matching interior, fireplace and bathroom mods :
➜ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12068]Cream Modern Interior[/url] ✨
➜ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11462]Cream Modern Fireplace[/url] 🔥
➜ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13223]Cream Modern Corner Bathroom[/url] 💄

This mod is a recolor / reinterpretation of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/665]Modern Kitchen[/url] by Static Opium, who I want to thanks for the inspiration !

💜🌈
